definitions.gloss: to become accustomed to living; to get used to living in a place
definitions.explanation: to become comfortable with one's living environment through experience

examples.japanese: {住|す}み{慣|な}れた{町|まち}を{離|はな}れたくない。
examples.english: I don't want to leave the town I've grown used to living in.

examples.japanese: {半年|はんとし}で{新|あたら}しい{場所|ばしょ}に{住|す}み{慣|な}れた。
examples.english: I got used to living in the new place in half a year.

examples.japanese: {住|す}み{慣|な}れたアパートを{出|で}るのは{寂|さび}しい。
examples.english: It's sad to leave the apartment I've become comfortable living in.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
{住|す}む (to live) + {慣|な}れる (to become accustomed)

CONJUGATION:
- {住|す}み{慣|な}れる (dictionary form)
- {住|す}み{慣|な}れた (past - commonly used as modifier)
- {住|す}み{慣|な}れている (currently accustomed)

COMMON USAGE:
- {住|す}み{慣|な}れた{場所|ばしょ} - a place one is used to living
- {住|す}み{慣|な}れた{町|まち} - a town one is comfortable in
- {住|す}み{慣|な}れた{家|いえ} - a home one is accustomed to

PATTERN:
~{慣|な}れる compound verbs (become used to ~):
- {聞|き}き{慣|な}れる - become used to hearing
- {食|た}べ{慣|な}れる - become used to eating
- {見慣|みな}れる - become used to seeing
- {使|つか}い{慣|な}れる - become used to using
